question: Which book is commonly referred to by chemists as a collection of recommendations on inorganic chemical nomenclature published at irregular intervals by the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC)?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Red book"**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry **publishes many books.
 
• These are divided into seven color books: **Gold, Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, White, and Red.**
 
• Now, the **eighth book **is also available - **The Silver book.**
 
• The **nomenclature of Inorganic chemistry** is referred to as **Red Book.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bluebook - **Nomenclature of organic chemistry.
 
• **Orange book -** Compendium of Analytical Nomenclature.
 
• **Green book -** Quantities, units, and symbols in physical chemistry. 
 
• **Gold book -** Compendium of chemical terminology.
 
• **Purple book -** Compendium of macromolecular terminology and nomenclature.
